title: Hanasato Minori — Positive Flower〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, time for another great practice!
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
Phew... Okay, next stretch...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Shizuku, you're already here?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how I told the fans that I'd do my best during our last stream?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means I'll need to start working even harder than I have been. Or rather, I want to work harder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Shizuku's feeling better!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I wanted to thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi told me that you said you like me just the way I am.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The Shizuku from Cheerful * Days had a mysterious quality about her, but was so great at singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She felt like someone who was so far out of anyone's reach and it was always so wonderful seeing her like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I think I like Shizuku as she is now more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
So Airi told you about that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. After hearing that, I decided I need to try even harder for you and all the other fans who feel the same way about me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really do appreciate it. So thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I hope we can continue doing our best together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You can push a little harder than that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Got it! Here we go!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hnng...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, was that too much?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No. Go ahead and push a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, harder?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You know how I get tripped up and stumble a lot, right? I need to make sure I do plenty of stretching to avoid getting hurt.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that makes sense! Okay, I'll push a little harder then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I didn't realize Shizuku was putting in such an extra effort for the fans like this.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But her fans, myself included, always just saw her as the perfect idol.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Of course she was working hard.
She was at the center of Cheerful * Days.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But it's different now! I'm seeing just how much work she puts in every day!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... Okay, shall we switch?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Don't hold back, Shizuku! Push as hard as you can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Got it. Let me know if it hurts, though.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And now, the fans will get to see just how hard she works for them!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's probably gonna surprise a lot of people...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I think seeing her working so hard without ever giving up will help give everyone the courage to keep going as well!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I need to do the same...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ready? One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Owww...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no! I'm so sorry Minori!
I shouldn't have started that strong.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, it's all right! Please do that again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... Okay, here we go then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I need to keep working harder! More, more, more!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to be the kind of idol who can inspire courage and hope for everyone!)
